goals: Set up the base integration test environment, including Spring context, database initialization, and RabbitMQ container.
Provide common utility methods for MockMvc testing, OAuth authentication, JSON API serialization, and API error validation for derived test classes.
activities: Start the RabbitMQ container with network configurations and admin credentials
Build MockMvc with the web application context and Spring Security
Configure the ObjectMapper to exclude empty values during serialization
Initialize the ResourceConverter with the ObjectMapper and supported entity classes
